study type: Prospective Feasibility Study with Cross-sectional Survey
outcome: User satisfaction with the MOMitor(tm) app
cohort: The study included 535 postpartum women who enrolled in a 6-week intervention using the MOMitor(tm) app.
finding: Mobile apps like MOMitor(tm) can be a useful tool for monitoring postpartum women's health, with valued benefits including support in symptom monitoring, ease of reaching clinicians, and helpful notifications, although engagement levels may vary.
cross-section timing: At the end of the 6-week postpartum intervention
